entries.379314df8469553e: This business model is close to EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Service): it centers on the AI introduction and operation platform “ABEJA Platform” and supports customers’ AI adoption in a single package, from consulting through to operation. The transformation domain, which is responsible for designing and building systems, earns flow-type revenue (per-contract), while the operations domain, which is responsible for running them, earns stock-type recurring revenue; the 2 domains are closely linked, as feedback gained from operations feeds into improving the accuracy of system design.

entries.4b76b0cd9145c1eb: Under the corporate philosophy 'Implementing a Richer World,' the company develops, introduces and operates the ABEJA Platform, the foundation system for supporting the introduction of AI into mission-critical operations. The company has a single segment, the digital platform business. Built around the ABEJA Platform, the company runs its business in two areas: the Transformation Area, which provides AI introduction support and related services, and the Operation Area, which handles subsequent operations through collaboration between people and AI. Its business model is close to that of an EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Service). Drawing on know-how from supporting AI introduction for more than 300 companies across a wide range of industries and business types, it provides integrated support to match customer needs, from consulting through to operations on the ABEJA Platform. Operating results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were revenue of ¥3,585,409 thousand (up 29.6% year on year), operating profit of ¥445,886 thousand (up 53.6%), ordinary profit of ¥451,978 thousand (up 57.7%) and net income of ¥448,268 thousand (up 105.0%), with higher revenue and higher profit. Its main customers are Sakura Internet Inc. (17.2% of total sales) and SOMPO Holdings, Inc. (¥461,580 thousand, 12.9%).

entries.cef79dc60e7900e6: With the corporate philosophy “Implementing a Richer World,” the company is a single-segment company in the digital platform business that develops, introduces and operates ABEJA Platform, its foundation system, to support AI adoption for mission-critical operations (from the securities report for the fiscal year ended August 2025).
entries.f2507eaf8c79fbce: This domain handles operation through collaboration between people and AI on ABEJA Platform, and is positioned as the operation phase. Its main revenue is stock-type recurring revenue, and it currently covers multiple industries including retail, real estate, manufacturing and finance. As a specific example, it provides "ABEJA Insight for Retail," built on ABEJA Platform, mainly to the retail industry; through devices such as cameras installed in stores, it analyzes consumer flow lines and estimates age and gender, visualizing and quantifying consumer behavior from store entry to purchase, which leads to understanding store issues and improving operations. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 126.7% of the same period of the previous year, and 23.4% of the total.
entries.fc0de5e405c47889: This domain provides support for introducing ABEJA Platform in response to customer needs and its peripheral services, and is positioned as the system-building and construction phase. Because system building and construction proceed in stages, much of the revenue comes from flow-type (per-engagement) contracts; however, as it is a planned process over a long period, the proportion of repeat customers is high, and the share of revenue from repeat enterprise customers is 88.8% (fiscal year ended August 2025). It provides hands-on support from formulating and sharing management-level and company-wide visions, through planning to realize those visions, to introducing ABEJA Platform in line with business processes, and also promotes the development of in-house digital talent at customer companies through AI training and other programs. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were 130.5% of the same period of the previous year, and 76.6% of the total.
